description.value:
Your devices can emit a disrupting pulse that causes tech to malfunction. You gain the following new mod.

  • Glitch Pulse (weapon): Strikes from the modded weapon disrupt technology. On a hit with the modded weapon, the target must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:class|options:inflicts:glitching] save against your class DC with the following results.

    Critical Success The creature is immune to glitch pulse mods for 24 hours.

    Success The creature and its gear are unaffected.

    Failure If the creature has the tech trait, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Glitching]{Glitching 3} for 1 round. Otherwise, one random item with the tech trait in the creature's possession becomes glitching 3 for 1 round, beginning with items they're wielding or holding.

    Critical Failure As failure, but glitching 3 for 1 minute.
